notes.title: September 24 Clarsus Mountain & Dragon Raid Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611664/5007fadc091d2ef615a2abe211641624859beea6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]4Story: The Original – September 24 Update[/b][/p][p]Heroes, prepare yourselves! The upcoming update will bring exciting new content and challenges to 4Story: The Original.[/p][p][/p][h3]🔥 Update Highlights[/h3][olist][*][p][b]Level Cap Increase[/b] – Push your limits with a new maximum level of [b]99[/b]![/p][/*][*][p][b]Mentor-Mentee System[/b] – Team up and grow stronger together with the new mentoring feature.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Clarsus Mountain Map[/b] – Explore the newly added Clarsus Mountain, full of dangers and secrets.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dragon Raid[/b] – Face the mighty dragons in an epic new raid battle![/p][/*][/olist][p]Join the adventure, rise to new heights, and claim your glory![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611664/707c3d1820560be3875fe0e090e58c0d71bc5172.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Also, enjoy the coupon rotation for select cash items in the shop. Please note that some items are available exclusively through coupons.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611664/8b0735d5a2a747ab2149e78bd100e0a14dcc9981.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And finally, the daily event schedule you’ve all been waiting for! In the schedule, you will notice that we introduced a new PvP/PvE event called [i]Monster Invasion[/i]. In this event, a single boss monster will be summoned multiple times in Gebura, the disputed region, and you’ll have to battle other players to claim the spot. Please note that the party leader should set the distribution type to [i]Evenly Distributed[/i] so that each party member receives one mystery box.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611664/979e55cef5ae554bb1787a4f5d71aa093a2be1df.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The battlefield is waiting—step forward, claim your destiny, and make your legend in 4Story![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
